text:
Priya: short huddle  need a clear post-launch plan for next 2 sprints: balance critical customer fixes vs. UX polish.
Ben: agree. suggest a triage rubric so tickets don't stall.
Carlos: rubric = customer-impact x reproducibility x perf-signal. if blocking or CI-repro -> fast lane.
Tara: reserve 20% sprint buffer for surprises. also perf regressions (p99 +15% or error +5%) auto-escalate.
Aisha: SLA: 48h ack, 5 business day plan. delivery target = next 1-2 sprints.
Priya: rotation: one fast-lane engineer per sprint. owners template: quality=Carlos, comms=Ben, release=Tara.
Ben: rollout guardrail: canary 2%->10%->50% with smoke checks. ops-bot will post results.
ops-bot: created canary pipeline: infra/canary-mini v1  smoke jobs queued. :robot_face:
Carlos: release checklist to add to cards:
- unit/integration smoke; canary health; pilot verify (if customer-impact); quality eval (hallucination check); rollback owner.
Aisha: will tag backlog items with customer-impact, dev-days, acceptance-criteria and run a 15m pre-groom to pick top 8.
Priya: by EOD add dev-days + acceptance criteria to cards. confirm at 11am. :thumbsup:
